name: Heartbreak's damage base carries the tooltip's $sps*0.5 + $spi*1 terms (#6453)
contract: Heartbreak 520314 (ranks 520836-520838, 572895-572898) reads '${$m1+0+$sps*0.5+$spi*1} Shadow damage' on effect 0, a SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH with DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue is deterministic and the two additive terms are the whole difference. In this client's tooltip dialect $spi is Spirit (Blood Veil 504263 implements its $SPI*1.5 term as caster->GetStat(STAT_SPIRIT) in AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp), and $sps is the spell's own school spell power (Heartbreak is SchoolMask 32, and Blood Shard scaling in AscensionBloodmageBloodShards.cpp reads its $SP terms as SpellBaseDamageBonusDone(SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_SHADOW) * coefficient). bloodmage_vitality_scaling::ModifySpellEffectBaseValue (AscensionBloodmageVitality.cpp) already adds stat terms to Bloodmage bases through this exact hook, but its guard only accepted SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL effects, so Heartbreak's HEALTH_LEECH damage read as the bare DBC base: the level-80 fixture measured spell_effect_value 781 and the landed spell_damage_total was also 781 - neither term applied. The fix accepts HEALTH_LEECH for the Heartbreak ranks and adds shadow spell power * 0.5 + Spirit * 1 to the base value. This scenario measures the base value across two gear changes with ratio assertions that are 0 before the fix. Phase A equips Maghia's Misguided Quill 49686 (+1000 Spirit, base item_template, already the fixture in bloodmage-vitality-for-later-spirit-heal.json); the hidden spell power is unchanged, so the base-value delta must be exactly 1.0x the Spirit gained. Phase B equips QA Test +2000 Spell Power Ring 38484 (+10000 spell power to every school); it adds no Spirit, so the base-value delta must be exactly 0.5x the spell power gained. Each phase takes its own before/after snapshots, so the terms are isolated from one another, and the +-1 int32 truncation on each subtraction moves either ratio by at most ~0.002, far inside the 0.95..1.05 and 0.49..0.51 windows. spell_effect_value calls SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue(caster) directly (CoAGameplayTest.cpp), which runs this hook, so it is the exact function under test; the damage pipeline carries it to the hit unchanged because no spell_bonus_data row or EffectBonusMultiplier exists for Heartbreak (the earlier probe measured spell_damage_total == spell_effect_value == 781 exactly). The Empowered rider is untouched: HeartbreakPower only runs on effect 1 and only when the cast is empowered. Expected before the fix: both ratios are 0 (the base value does not depend on either stat). Expected after: Phase A 1.0, Phase B 0.5.

SETUP: the quill did not move shadow spell power
DISCRIMINATING: the base value rises by exactly 1x the Spirit gained
